tasks.title: Create a workspace as Product Owner
tasks.description: createWorkspace writes the workspace with a unique slug and 12-hex invite code, adds the creator as owner/member with the Product Owner system role, and updates the user's workspace list and activeWorkspace; validateUpdateWorkspace enforces the 60-character name.

tasks.title: List, read and switch workspaces
tasks.description: getMyWorkspaces projects only switcher data; getWorkspaceBySlug checks membership and strips member emails without users:read and the invite code without users:write/settings:manage (permissionsOf); switchWorkspace sets activeWorkspace for members.

tasks.title: Rename, rotate the invite code and toggle the 2FA policy
tasks.description: updateWorkspace and regenerateInviteCode behind settings:manage, with the OWN_TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED guard and workspace.updated / workspace.invite_code_regenerated activity entries.

tasks.title: Join a workspace with an invite code
tasks.description: joinWorkspace validates the 12-hex code, refuses a second join, assigns the Viewer role through findDefaultRole (never from the body) and registers the workspace on the user.

tasks.title: List members by role seniority
tasks.description: getWorkspaceMembers populates user and role, projects public fields, drops broken entries and sorts with roleRank then name.

tasks.title: Change a member's role within the privilege ceiling
tasks.description: changeMemberRole refuses self-changes and owner changes, resolves the role with findAssignableRole and applies canGrantRole to both the held and the requested role, then records member.role_changed.

tasks.title: Remove a member
tasks.description: removeMember refuses the owner and the caller, applies the privilege ceiling to the member's current role, unassigns their tasks, pulls the workspace from their list and clears a stale activeWorkspace.

tasks.title: Leave a workspace
tasks.description: leaveWorkspace lets any member except the owner leave with the same cleanup and writes member.left.

tasks.title: Define the permission catalogue and the system roles
tasks.description: server/src/config/permissions.ts declares the area:action keys with labels and groups, the five SYSTEM_ROLES, deriveActions and hasPermission.

tasks.title: Enforce permissions in one middleware
tasks.description: requirePermission resolves the slug, loads the workspace by membership, resolves the role, applies the workspace 2FA policy, narrows API-token permissions to their scopes and attaches req.workspace, req.role and req.permissions; every workspace route declares it after protect.

tasks.title: Seed system roles and repair orphaned memberships
tasks.description: seedSystemRoles upserts each system role with workspaceId null and repairMemberRoles fills a missing roleId (legacy strings mapped, owner to Product Owner, otherwise Viewer); both run through ensureReady in server/src/app.ts.

tasks.title: Create an invitation with a role the inviter may grant
tasks.description: createInvitation normalises the email, resolves the role with findAssignableRole, applies canGrantRole, expires an earlier pending invitation, stores only the token hash with a 3-day expiry and emails the accept link.

tasks.title: List and cancel pending invitations
tasks.description: listInvitations returns pending, unexpired rows without the token; cancelInvitation flips a pending row to expired and 404s malformed or foreign ids.

tasks.title: Preview, accept and decline by token
tasks.description: getInvitationByToken is public and masks the address; accept claims the row atomically, matches the signed-in address, re-resolves the role and adds the member once; decline marks the row declined.

phases.name: Custom roles and permission catalogue endpoint

tasks.title: List workspace roles and the permission catalogue
tasks.description: listWorkspaceRoles returns system roles plus the workspace's own custom roles (system first); listPermissions groups the catalogue for the role editor under GET /api/roles/permissions.

tasks.title: Create and update a custom role
tasks.description: createCustomRole and updateCustomRole validate the name/description, check getInvalidPermissions, apply withinOwnPermissions, and refuse a duplicate name in the workspace (hasRoleNameConflict).

tasks.title: Delete a custom role that nobody holds
tasks.description: deleteCustomRole resolves the role with findCustomRoleOr404, refuses when a member still holds it (409) and records role.deleted.

tasks.title: Load permissions for the workspace in view
tasks.description: PermissionProvider derives the slug from the route, requests /auth/currentuser?workspaceSlug=..., resets when logged out and exposes user, workspace, role, permissions, actions, can() and hasRole() through usePermissions.

tasks.title: Gate the member and invitation screens
tasks.description: TeamMembersPage and InviteMemberModal show the role control, remove action and invite form only with the matching permission, and workspace lib.canManageWorkspace drives the settings affordances.

tasks.title: Show the invite link, rename and the 2FA policy
tasks.description: WorkspaceSettingsPage and WorkspaceSecurityCard expose rename, invite-code rotation and the require2fa switch, disabling the switch and explaining the lockout when the viewer lacks two-factor or settings:manage.

tasks.title: Unit test the middleware and the role rules
tasks.description: server/src/__tests__/permissionMiddleware.test.ts and rbacSecurity.test.ts mock the models and assert every 401/400/403 branch, the attached context and the privilege ceiling with the real catalogue.

tasks.title: Integration test the workspace and role flows
tasks.description: rbac.test.ts, workspaces.test.ts, workspaceJoin.test.ts, invitationsAdmin.test.ts, invitationsFlow.test.ts and the workspace-policy block of twoFactor.test.ts run over HTTP with a real MongoDB.

tasks.title: Keep every workspace query scoped
tasks.description: Controllers read the workspace from req.workspace and filter by req.workspace._id (CON-106); membership-aware lookups use 'members.user' so a non-member cannot observe a workspace.

tasks.title: Validate identifiers before querying
tasks.description: findAssignableRole rejects non-strings and malformed ObjectIds without a query, and findCustomRoleOr404 answers 404 so odd ids never produce a CastError 500 (CON-516).

tasks.title: Run the repository quality gates
tasks.description: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter server test, pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter client lint, pnpm --filter client build, plus the browser check on /<slug>/settings and /<slug>/team (CON-402, CON-703).
